speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Captain Pom! Wake up! The Feline Armada has stolen every squeaky toy in the neighborhood, and they took the puppies too.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: Not the puppies! And not my squeaky hedgehog! Biscuit, fire up the rocket boots.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Arrow keys to fly. Space bar to... well. You know what you do. Aim it at the cats, Captain.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: Lunch was a big one. Let's go.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Sergeant Whiskers is running for the fence! The yard is ours again.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: That cat has stared at me through the window for six years. Feels good. Onward to Maple Street!

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Maple Street is crawling with tuxedos. They dive fast, so keep moving.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: I've walked this street a thousand times. Every hydrant is an old friend.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Watch for the Scottish Folds later on. They carry lost pups in their paws. Boop one and catch the pup!

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Tuxedo Tom has lost his top hat. Two routes ahead, Captain: the Dog Park or Bodega Alley.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: Decisions, decisions. Both smell amazing.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Barkwood Dog Park. Duchess Fluffbottom has taken the whole lawn for her afternoon nap.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: The dog park belongs to the dogs. That's literally the name.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: The Duchess is gone and the lawn is free! A golden retriever just gave me a tennis ball. I'll keep it forever.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Head for the rooftops. The Armada's signal is coming from up high.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Bodega Alley. Big Sal runs things here. He's not mean, just very, very territorial.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: I just want a bacon egg and cheese and the puppies back. Is that so much?

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Big Sal tipped his ears at you. In cat, that's practically a hug. You've earned some respect around here.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: Respect is nice. Bacon is nicer. Up to the rooftops!

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: The Manhattan skyline. Madame Mau is singing from a water tower and the whole block is awake.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: The city looks like a box of glowing kibble from up here.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: Madame Mau finally stopped singing. Somewhere, a neighbor is finally sleeping.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Two leads, Captain. A cat cafe full of suspicious lattes, or the fish market docks.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: The Purrfect Cup Cafe. It's a front. The Armada runs its operations from behind the pastry case.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: I'll have a pup cup. And a side of justice.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Barista Patches is out of kittens and out of espresso. The trail leads to the Yarn Factory.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: I left a generous tip. In turds, but still.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Fish Market Docks. Captain Mainsail's crew is loading stolen squeaky toys onto a boat.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: Not my hedgehog! Full speed ahead!

speaker: Captain Pom
text: The boat is ours. The toys are safe. It smells like tuna and victory.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: The crates are labeled YARN FACTORY. That's our next stop.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: The Yarn Factory. Every ball of yarn the Armada throws was spun right here.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: Shut it down. Then maybe roll around in it a little. For science.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Foreman Fold is tangled in his own yarn. Captain, the Armada is retreating to orbit!

speaker: Captain Pom
text: Then we're going to space. I have always wanted to go to space.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: The Stratosphere. Ace Pilot Sphynx is waiting for you in the clouds.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: My ears are flapping so hard right now. This is the best day of my life.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: The Sky Ace is out of the fight. Your memories are glowing, Captain. If you found enough, a secret route opens to the Catnip Nebula.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: Every memory of my human makes me fly a little faster.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: The Litter Moon. Yes, it's exactly what it sounds like. Hold your nose.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: One small step for a dog. One giant leap over a clump.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Commodore Blue has surrendered the moon. The Scratching-Post Station is just ahead.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: I'm going to need a very long bath after this.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: The Catnip Nebula! Very few dogs have ever seen it. The cats in here are... extremely relaxed.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: Everything smells like mint and naps. Focus, Pom. Focus.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: The Kingpin just rolled over and purred. I think we're friends now?

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Friends who still stole the puppies. The Station awaits.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: Scratching-Post Station. Admiral Floof keeps the Empress's schedule. Nap, snack, nap, conquer, nap.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: I respect the nap schedule. I do not respect the conquering.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: The Station has fallen! The Meowthership is right in front of you, Captain.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: Hold on, little pups. I'm coming.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: This is it. The Meowthership. Empress Fluffington is aboard, along with every stolen toy and pup.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: Biscuit, if I don't make it back, tell my human I was a good girl.

speaker: Commander Biscuit
text: You ARE a good girl, Captain. The best. Now go get them.

speaker: Empress Fluffington
text: Stop! Stop booping me! Fine, FINE. Take your toys. I only wanted someone to play with.

speaker: Captain Pom
text: You could have just asked. Dogs love to play. That's our whole thing.

speaker: Empress Fluffington
text: ...Really? Even with a cat?

speaker: Captain Pom
text: Come by the backyard on Saturday. Bring the squeaky hedgehog. Biscuit, set a course for home.

speaker: Sergeant Whiskers
text: This yard is Armada turf now, poodle. Ten-hut!

speaker: Sergeant Whiskers
text: Retreat! Regroup! ...Is that a sunbeam?

speaker: Tuxedo Tom
text: Black tie only, Captain. You are underdressed.

speaker: Tuxedo Tom
text: My cummerbund! You will pay for the dry cleaning.

speaker: Duchess Fluffbottom
text: A commoner. In MY park. How perfectly ghastly.

speaker: Duchess Fluffbottom
text: Fetch my groomer. And my fainting couch.

speaker: Big Sal
text: Nobody flies through my alley without paying the tuna tax.

speaker: Big Sal
text: Okay, okay. You got moxie, kid. Sal respects moxie.

speaker: Madame Mau
text: The rooftops belong to the night, darling. And the night is mine.

speaker: Madame Mau
text: Hmph. The moon will remember this, little poodle.

speaker: Barista Patches
text: One extra-hot latte, coming right at your face!

speaker: Barista Patches
text: We are closed! CLOSED! ...Tip jar is by the door.

speaker: Captain Mainsail
text: Arr! This catch is mine, ye soggy little mop!

speaker: Captain Mainsail
text: Abandon ship! Save the sardines first!

speaker: Foreman Fold
text: Shift starts now. Every ball of yarn rolls for the Empress.

speaker: Foreman Fold
text: I am clocking out. Forever. Tell the union.

speaker: Ace Pilot Sphynx
text: No fur, no drag, no mercy. Try to keep up, fluffball.

speaker: Ace Pilot Sphynx
text: Mayday! Mayday! Somebody get me a sweater!

speaker: Commodore Blue
text: Welcome to the Litter Moon. Mind the craters. They are not craters.

speaker: Commodore Blue
text: Tactical withdrawal. Very tactical. Extremely withdrawn.

speaker: The Catnip Kingpin
text: Whoa, duuude. Have you ever, like, really looked at a toy mouse?

speaker: The Catnip Kingpin
text: Bummer, man. I am gonna go stare at a wall for a while.

speaker: Admiral Floof
text: Battle stations! And someone brush my tail, it is a mess.

speaker: Admiral Floof
text: The station is yours. The hairballs in the vents are a gift.

speaker: Empress Fluffington
text: So the poodle finally comes to kneel. How adorable.

speaker: Empress Fluffington
text: Fine. FINE. Take your silly pups. I wanted a nap anyway.
